description: This Java class provides utility methods for byte manipulation, including conversions between bytes and integers or floats, pattern matching within byte arrays, and array operations, serving as a general helper in handling raw byte data within the project.

classes.name: ByteUtil
classes.description: Final utility class that offers static methods for byte array manipulation and conversion tasks, used internally within the project for handling byte data.

methods.name: asUnsignedInt
methods.description: Converts a byte into an unsigned int value.

methods.name: asSignedInt
methods.description: Converts a byte array into a signed int, considering byte order.

methods.name: asUnsignedInt
methods.description: Converts a byte array into an unsigned int, considering byte order.

methods.name: asByte
methods.description: Converts an int to a byte.

methods.name: asFloat
methods.description: Converts a subset of a byte array into a float value, given an offset and length.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Converts a byte to an int.

methods.name: matchOnes
methods.description: Checks if all bits specified by the mask are set to 1 in the byte.

methods.name: matchZeroes
methods.description: Checks if all bits specified by the mask are set to 0 in the byte.

methods.name: byteListToBytes
methods.description: Copies a list of Byte objects into a byte array.

methods.name: indexOfBytes
methods.description: Finds the starting index of a pattern byte array within another byte array, using the failure function for efficient search.

methods.name: computeFailure
methods.description: Preprocessing step for pattern matching, computes failure function for KMP algorithm.
